knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Variables of Interest

- **Gene:** *PTX3* (pentraxin 3), an inflammatory marker previously linked to preeclampsia
- **Continuous covariate:** maternal baseline 25-hydroxyvitamin D (ng/mL)
- **Categorical covariate 1:** pregnancy outcome (Normal vs Preeclampsia)
- **Categorical covariate 2 (derived from a continuous variable):** vitamin D status from `mat_vitD`
  (Deficient < 20, Insufficient 20–29.9, Sufficient ≥ 30 ng/mL)
  
```{r packages}
# loading tidyverse library
library(tidyverse)
```

### Load the raw files

```{r load}
covar <- read_csv("data/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")
exp <- read_csv("data/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv")
geneNames <- read_csv("data/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")

# Quick look at each file
glimpse(covar)
dim(exp) # 500 probes (rows) with 157 samples (+ 1 additional probe ID column)
head(geneNames)
```

## Data Cleaning

### Cleaning the covariate data

Each covariate value is stored as text such as `"bmi_kg/m2: 37.52"`, so keep only the part
after `": "` and convert numbers to numeric.

```{r clean-covar}
covar_clean <- covar |> 
  # Rename first column name by position
  rename(subjectID = 1) |> 
  # For every column except the IDs, keep only the text after ": "; consulted
  # the help of Claude for this step to help with str_removal, detecting patterns
  mutate(across(-c(subjectID, geoID),
                ~ str_remove(.x, "^.*: "))) |> 
  # Convert the continuous variables from text to numeric
  mutate(across(c(mat_age_yrs, 
                  delivery_gestAge_wks, 
                  sampleCollection_gestAge_wks,
                  mat_BMI, 
                  mat_vitD), 
                as.numeric)) |> 
  mutate(
    # Pregnancy outcome as a factor, with normal and preeclampsia levels
    preg_preeclampsia = factor(preg_preeclampsia, 
                               levels = c("Normal", "Preeclampsia")),
    # Turn asthma into a labeled factor, either 0 or 1
    mat_asthma = factor(mat_asthma, 
                        levels = c("0", "1"), 
                        labels = c("Healthy", "Asthma")),
    # convert to factor variable
    batch_Microarray = factor(batch_Microarray),
    # turn continuous mat_vitD to categorical vitD_status variable
    vitD_status = cut(mat_vitD,
                      breaks = c(-Inf, 20, 30, Inf),
                      right  = FALSE,   # intervals are [low, high)
                      labels = c("Deficient (<20)", 
                                 "Insufficient (20-29.9)", 
                                 "Sufficient (30+)"))
  )

summary(covar_clean)
count(covar_clean, preg_preeclampsia, vitD_status)
```

### Attach gene names using left_join; matching gene names
```{r gene}
exp_named <- exp |> 
  # PROBE-ID column has no header, so rename it
  rename(PROBEID = 1) |> 
  # add the gene column
  left_join(geneNames, by = "PROBEID") |>    
  relocate(GENE, .after = PROBEID)

# Check that every probe matched a gene name and there are no duplicate genes
sum(is.na(exp_named$GENE))
any(duplicated(exp_named$GENE))

# Keep only PTX3, change from wide to long format
ptx3 <- exp_named |> 
  filter(GENE == "PTX3") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("GSM"),
               names_to  = "geoID",
               values_to = "PTX3_exp")

head(ptx3)
```

### Combine covariate data with gene expression data using geoID
```{r merge}
# Check that the sample IDs are the same set in both files before joining
setequal(ptx3$geoID, covar_clean$geoID)

analysis_df <- covar_clean |> 
  inner_join(ptx3, by = "geoID")

# Should be 157 rows: one per sample, none lost or duplicated
nrow(analysis_df)

n_distinct(analysis_df$geoID)

# Spot-check one sample against the raw expression file
analysis_df |>  
  filter(geoID == "GSM2264346") |>  
  pull(PTX3_exp)

exp |> 
  rename(PROBEID = 1) |>  
  filter(PROBEID == 8083594) |> 
  pull(GSM2264346)
```

## Submission 1 Plots

### Shared Theme
```{r theme}
# One theme for consistency across all plots
theme_pub <- theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

outcome_colors <- c("Normal" = "#4C72B0", "Preeclampsia" = "#C44E52")
```

### Histogram of PTX3 gene expression
```{r histogram}
p_hist <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = PTX3_exp)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "grey60", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(PTX3_exp)), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of PTX3 Expression",
       x = "PTX3 expression (log2 intensity)",
       y = "Number of samples",
       caption = "Dashed line = median; n = 157") +
  theme_pub

p_hist
ggsave("figures/histogram_PTX3.png", p_hist, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

### Scatterplot comparing vitamin D vs. PTX3 gene expression
```{r scatter}
scatter <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = mat_vitD, y = PTX3_exp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = preg_preeclampsia), 
             alpha = 0.7, 
             size = 2.5) +
   # overall linear trend + 95% CI
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", 
              color = "black", 
              se = TRUE) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors) +
  labs(title = "Maternal Vitamin D vs PTX3 Expression",
       x = "Maternal 25(OH)D at baseline (ng/mL)",
       y = "PTX3 expression (log2 intensity)",
       color = "Pregnancy outcome") +
  theme_pub

scatter

# save in figures folder so don't need to regenerate again
ggsave("figures/scatter_vitD_PTX3.png", 
       scatter, 
       width = 7, 
       height = 5, 
       dpi = 300)

```

### 8. Boxplot of PTX3 by vitamin D status and pregnancy outcome

```{r boxplot}
box <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = vitD_status, y = PTX3_exp, 
                                 fill = preg_preeclampsia)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, 
               alpha = 0.8,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
             size = 1.2, 
             alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors) +
  labs(title = "PTX3 Expression by Vitamin D Status and Outcome",
       x = "Maternal vitamin D status (ng/mL)",
       y = "PTX3 expression (log2 intensity)",
       fill = "Pregnancy outcome") +
  theme_pub

box
ggsave("figures/boxplot_PTX3_vitD_outcome.png", 
       box, 
       width = 8, 
       height = 5, 
       dpi = 300)
```
